contract_precedence.generic_v0_31: requires nonempty disjoint pilot and confirmatory partitions and freezes minimum_estimable_blocks, but does not weaken a stricter system-specific preregistration
contract_precedence.system_specific_v0_65: requires at least 3 pilot spatial blocks and 6 confirmatory spatial blocks, with no response-defined fallback
contract_precedence.v0_55: requires spatial transfer for fresh confirmation
contract_precedence.decision: the stricter pre-response system-specific spatial support requirement remains binding

deduction.reason: six lakes cannot furnish the nine disjoint spatial blocks required by the already-frozen 3-pilot plus 6-confirmatory support rule
lake_crosswalk_still_useful_for: within-lake source restrictions or sensitivity definitions after geometry is valid
lake_crosswalk_not_sufficient_for: v0.31 spatial-transfer partition construction under the v0.65 system contract

required_spatial_resolution_before_v0_11.preferred_route: recover exact response-independent Lat/Long for all 42 sampling plots and construct the frozen graph/block design exactly as prospectively specified
required_spatial_resolution_before_v0_11.allowable_alternative: a separately justified response-independent spatial partition yielding at least nine disjoint spatial units while preserving the v0.55 spatial-transfer requirement
forbidden_alternatives: treat the six lakes as sufficient disjoint pilot and confirmatory blocks
lower the 3-pilot or 6-confirmatory block requirements to fit the available lake count
use island identity alone as a nominal block label without a pre-response spatial-transfer justification
derive blocks from beetle, bird, plant, richness, or other biological response values
digitize approximate coordinates by eye from a published map

other_preintake_blocker.rule: the v0.68 prospectively allowlisted habitat-structure reference must still be recovered or the system must STOP before biological response; v0.70 does not weaken that gate

next_valid_scientific_event: recover exact response-independent coordinates for all 42 boreal islands, plus a prospectively safe local habitat reference; only then construct and freeze the spatial operator, v0.31 partition, and v0.42 quality contract before any burned-pilot response
